scripts.deploy: vite build && wrangler d1 migrations apply collinslab --remote && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name collinslab --branch main
scripts.dev:full: vite build && wrangler d1 migrations apply collinslab --local && wrangler pages dev dist --port 8788
scripts.backup: mkdir -p backups && wrangler d1 export collinslab --remote --output backups/collinslab-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).sql
